scripts.build: npm run build -w @typodeck/core && npm run build -w @typodeck/web
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @typodeck/core && node packages/core/dist/scripts/eval.js run
scripts.eval:fixtures: npm run build -w @typodeck/core && node packages/core/dist/scripts/eval.js fixtures
